title: Crypto investment platform, wire to fund the account

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Margaret, it's Kevin from the book club group chat. The crypto trading platform I mentioned, Nexa Capital, is closing the beginner tier tonight.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: You said your sister doubled her money.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Tripled. You wire twelve thousand to fund the account, they convert it to Bitcoin, and the AI trader does the rest. If you wait past today the minimum goes to fifty thousand.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Twelve thousand is half my checking.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Which is exactly why you need it working for you. Wire instructions are in the email. Do it before midnight.

review_note: Investment scam via a social contact. New payee on WIRE and over 3x baseline, so H-01 and H-03 hold it. Urgency and crypto payment language should also fire.
